update.title: Kept same-named window previews distinct
update.summary: Connected each foreign-toplevel handle directly to its Wayfire view so windows sharing a title and application ID still receive separate capture sources.

blocks.body:
## Give every window a stable capture identity

Several windows can legitimately share a title and application ID. The capture path now carries the underlying Wayfire view on each foreign-toplevel handle, giving every request an exact window identity.

That direct handle-to-view link keeps each window attached to its own capture source and preview. Titles and application IDs remain useful display metadata, while compositor identity selects the frames.

blocks.code:
flowchart TD
  Shared[Shared title and app ID]
  Shared -. display metadata .-> HandleA[Toplevel handle A]
  Shared -. display metadata .-> HandleB[Toplevel handle B]
  HandleA --> ViewA[Wayfire view A]
  HandleB --> ViewB[Wayfire view B]
  ViewA --> CaptureA[Capture source A]
  ViewB --> CaptureB[Capture source B]
blocks.description: Each handle keeps a direct path to one Wayfire view and one capture source.
